long_biography.plain_text:
Autostar grew from a single BMW dealership into a specialist São Paulo retailer for premium cars and motorcycles. Giovanni Marco Delle Sedie became its principal shareholder alongside Maurício and Fernando Portella, holding majority interests across several operating companies. The network combined international marques with maintenance, parts, financing, insurance and vehicle-armouring services.

Delle Sedie's defining business position lay in ownership of this automotive-retail platform rather than vehicle manufacturing. Through its expansion, Autostar built an urban dealership network and specialist offerings around luxury vehicles. He remained a significant owner as the business joined a larger Brazilian dealership group, preserving economic participation in the combined platform while its operations were integrated.
